messages:
Rae (networking): quick sync—followup from the cross-account experiments. we need a clear lease & multi-AZ fallback model for ephemeral agents.
Omar (infra): agreed. current prototype flips immediately on any health gap which causes flapping under noisy networks. we need lease windows + jittered renewals.
Lena (security): security constraints: agent assumes a customer role for registration. prefer the agent to request a short-lived lease token from control plane and then exchange it for the role session to avoid long-lived permissions.
Devon (product): customers care about SLA and predictable failover. they asked what happens to in-flight requests during a handoff—need to document expected packet loss and recovery time.
Rae (networking): proposed model: 1) agent obtains a lease token TTL=90s, renew at 1/3rd TTL with random +/-10s jitter. 2) on missed renewals (two consecutive) control plane marks endpoint degraded and triggers route shift to relay. 3) DNS/route TTL = 30s.
Omar (infra): also add a soft-grace window for attach ops: if an ENI attach starts but doesn't finish within 12s, keep the control plane in "attaching" state for 30s before failing over (to avoid transient cloud API slowness).
Lena (security): audit: every lease grant/renew/revoke must be immutably logged (customer account id, agent id, controlplane actor). logs retained 180d for now. also revoke path must immediately invalidate any active session tokens.
Devon (product): UX items: show current path (relay / eni-wired / eni-attaching) and last failover reason in console. include an "expected impact" blurb: p99 latency delta and packet-loss estimate.
Rae (networking): header contract: when ENI path is active, preserve client ip via normal LB target behavior and set X-Redwood-Path: eni. when relay path active set X-Redwood-Path: relay and include X-Original-Client if known. always propagate X-Redwood-Request-Id.
Omar (infra): multi-AZ: agent must register in all AZs that customer subnets span. control plane will hold a preferred-AZ list and a fallback-AZ order. attach/registration should prefer local AZ targets to avoid cross-AZ egress.
Lena (security): firewall consideration: for customer security teams we should support IP whitelisting of our relay ranges and a cert-fingerprint assertion for ENI handshakes. provide a short MR for terraform snippets.
Rae (networking): example lease exchange flow (sketch):
```
# simplified flow
1) POST /controlplane/v1/leases {agent_id, endpoint_id} -> {lease_token, ttl}
2) agent sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity using lease_token -> session_creds
3) agent register target with local LB and open health ws using session_creds
```
Devon (product): billing note: when ENI path is used we surface egress estimate; when relay used we surface both customer->relay and relay->redwood egress. need copy for onboarding.
Omar (infra): telemetry additions: lease_grants_total, lease_renew_failures, attach_slide_ms, handoff_count, active_path_gauge (enum->string in UI). alert if lease_renew_failures rate > 0.2% over 10m.
Lena (security): incident playbook: if a customer suspects compromise, they can revoke the role; control plane must honor revocation and shift traffic to relay within 60s. we need a test for immediate revocation path.
Rae (networking): rollout plan: start with beta for customers who opt-in to eni-preferred + warm-pool. measure handoff_count and p99 delta for 2 weeks. if stable, add auto-enroll suggestions for high-volume customers.
ops-bot: created ticket ARCH-4822 "ephemeral-agent-lease-and-az-fallback" assigned to @Rae
Devon (product): RFC TODOs: lease spec, renew jitter algorithm, UI states, billing copy, revoke playbook, terraform examples. i'll own the onboarding copy.
Omar (infra): dev task: add deterministic backoff for attach attempts and a circuit breaker to stop flapping. i'll sketch tests for simulated AZ API latency.
Lena (security): i'll draft the minimal trust policy + revocation guide and run it by legal for the audit retention.
Rae (networking): cool. i'll assemble a short RFC and ping infra/security/product for review tomorrow. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
